title: Green Gobbler Fluorescent Green Water Tracing & Leak Detection Dye, 1 Gallon

comparisons.notes: Green Gobbler fluorescent water tracing dye, green, 1 gallon, maker's own store

amazon_match_notes: Woot offer data ASIN; listing is Green Water Tracing & Leak Detection Fluorescent Dye, 1 Gallon (Green Gobbler)
writeup: Green Gobbler's concentrated fluorescent green tracing dye comes in a full gallon jug and is used for leak tracing, overflow and discharge testing, and flow studies, and it glows under UV light. Woot has it for $19.99, while Green Gobbler's own store charges $34.99 for the same gallon. It's non-polluting and safe around wildlife, per the maker.
